weakest_scene.root_cause: This machine places its caption, its axis end labels, its mascot and the title block by fixed offsets instead of measuring occupied extents, so the label band, the caption band and the mascot band all resolve to the same y; the scene also instantiates a mascot while the persistent host figure is already on screen.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Lay out seg1 so no two text runs overlap: move the range caption below the track and clear of the 29%/35% end labels (or drop it — the end labels already say it), pull the headline off the deck line, keep the connector line out of the title block, and leave exactly ONE mascot in the scene with a clear zone around every label.
